tests: a package's read-only designer file opens an empty tab of its name besides the notice that it cannot be opened
steps:
1. In a project that references the VB package, open Packages/VB/Sources/DESIGNERS/tbObjectDesigner_PROPERTYPAGE.tbppage from Project Explorer.
2. The notification reads Can't open designer for a read-only document., and a tab of that name is added and selected, empty, with no close icon. A middle click closes it.
